jobs.description_text: Embedding AI-driven processes and standards across the business, this role ensures best practices are consistently upheld so BI, data and reporting remain the most trusted source of truth . It calls for a sound grasp of AI and a genuine can-do, forward-thinking mindset. Lead cross-functional efforts to embed AI/LLM capability into data sourcing, connectivity and reporting, driving smarter, more efficient ways of working across the organization. Proactively identify and build automation and AI opportunities across BI, quality tracking and customer service workflows to reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time. Support the build-out and scaling of AI tools already in flight (e.g. Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, AI-driven verbatim and ticket analysis) across the wider organization. Ensure best practices and data standards are consistently upheld, so outputs remain accurate and trusted as the single source of truth. Design and implement proactive alerting mechanisms that route client health and escalation signals to the relevant stakeholders in a timely manner, equipping account managers with full visibility ahead of client engagements. Identify ways to streamline workflows and reduce reliance on costly seat-based CRM licenses, moving colleagues onto more efficient, automated alternatives. Act as a confident representative of the team with stakeholders, stay current on AI developments and help drive forward-thinking initiatives across the business. Sound, hands-on grasp of AI/LLM concepts and tools (e.g. Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Power BI Copilot), with genuine enthusiasm for staying at the forefront of AI developments. Programming/scripting experience (e.g. Python, SQL, Power Automate or similar) sufficient to build and maintain data connectivity and automation solutions in the background. Experience or demonstrated aptitude in data sourcing, data integration, and business intelligence (BI) reporting environments, with proficiency in data base management (using Microsoft Fabric), data modelling, and data querying. Can-do, forward-thinking mindset – proactive , comfortable with ambiguity, and passionate about finding more efficient ways to do things through technology. Confident communicator , comfortable presenting to and influencing stakeholders at varying levels of seniority. Ability to translate technical work into clear knowledge documentation for non-technical audiences . Minimum 1 year working experience, prefer candidate with experience in Market Research, Customer Service or Operations is a plus, but mindset and technical aptitude matter more than sector background. Project Management aptitude, who can help to organize and manage tasks for team. jobs.description_text: We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Market Research Project Management candidate to lead end-to-end market research projects across global markets, with a primary focus on supporting US-based stakeholders and clients. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management expertise, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to improve project efficiency, decision-making, and execution. The Project Management Specialist will be responsible for planning, scheduling, coordinating, monitoring, and delivering complex market research and business initiatives while ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, and to the highest quality standards. Project Planning & Execution Lead multiple market research and business projects from initiation through completion. Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, risk registers, and resource plans. Build and maintain detailed project schedules using Smartsheet and other project management tools. Track project progress and proactively identify schedule, budget, and delivery risks. Ensure timely completion of project deliverables while maintaining quality standards. Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Facilitate project meetings, status reviews, and executive updates. Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, and mitigation plans effectively. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across global locations. AI-Enabled Project Management Utilize Artificial Intelligence tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or equivalent platforms to improve project planning, reporting, risk management, documentation, and productivity. Automate routine project management activities where appropriate. Drive AI adoption and recommend innovative approaches to improve operational efficiency. Generate project insights, dashboards, and executive summaries using AI-assisted solutions. Project Governance & Reporting Maintain project governance standards and ensure adherence to project management methodologies. Prepare weekly and monthly project health reports. Track KPIs, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items. Escalate critical issues proactively and recommend mitigation strategies. Continuous Improvement Identify process improvement opportunities and implement best practices. Contribute to the development of project management standards, templates, and frameworks. Document lessons learned and promote knowledge sharing across teams. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, Project Management related training (equivalent certification is preferred.) 3-5 years of demonstrated project management experience. Consistently deliver projects on time and within scope. Minimum 1+ years of experience managing market research, consumer insights, analytics, data operations, or related projects. Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects in a global environment. Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability. Effectively manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience working with US-based stakeholders or clients is highly desirable. Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, ability to confidently interact with senior leadership and global stakeholders. To build strong relationships with global stakeholders. Strong presentation and facilitation skills. Use AI-driven practices to improve project efficiency and reporting (Excellent understanding of Microsoft 365 tools including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and Copilot.)
